long-covid.title: Research Landscape of Chronic Pain and Neuropsychiatric Symptoms (1983-2025): A Comprehensive Bibliometric Analysis.
long-covid.authors: Quan, Xingpu, Fu, Xinrui, Lu, Tao, Lai, Jiandong et al.
long-covid.excerpt: Chronic pain affects a substantial proportion of the global adult population and is closely associated with neuropsychiatric symptoms, such as depression and anxiety, which may further worsen pain outcomes and increase mortality risk. However, development trends and research hotspots in this field remain insufficiently clarified.

long-covid.title: Measuring infectious disease stigma in the German population: Psychometric properties of stigma scales related to COVID-19, Long Covid and non-vaccination in a representative population sample.
long-covid.journal: Archives of public health = Archives belges de sante publique
long-covid.authors: Menzinger, Jule, Alpers, Carlotta, McLaren, Thomas, Danqa, Dafina et al.
long-covid.excerpt: The COVID-19 pandemic was widely accompanied by stigma towards certain groups of people, which can diminish efforts of disease control and exacerbate negative impacts of the disease itself. Research on COVID-19-related stigma in the German population is scarce and, internationally, is lacking validated and standardized measurement instruments.

long-covid.title: Receptor-binding autoantibodies are not associated with post-COVID fatigue.
long-covid.authors: Achleitner, Martin, Dänhardt, Juliane, Kardashi, Romina, Toepfner, Nicole et al.
long-covid.excerpt: Persistent fatigue is a common symptom following SARS-CoV-2 infection, but its underlying mechanisms remain incompletely understood. Autoantibodies targeting G-protein coupled receptors and other neurotransmitter-related receptors have been proposed as potential biomarkers or mediators of post-COVID symptoms.

long-covid.excerpt: COVID-19 can cause persistent symptoms that continue after the infection, condition known as long COVID. This study aimed to identify the prevalence of persistent signs and symptoms of COVID-19 in individuals with confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection and among healthcare workers.

long-covid.excerpt: Post-COVID-19 syndrome is burdensome and not yet adequately treatable, with persistent symptoms including fatigue, dyspnoea, and cognitive impairment. The Pan American Health Organisation recommends rigorous evaluation of potentially beneficial interventions.

long-covid.title: SARS-CoV-2-specific monoclonal antibody AER002 in Long COVID: an exploratory randomized phase 2a mechanistic trial.
long-covid.authors: Peluso, Michael J, Ryder, Dylan, Dalhuisen, Thomas, Chu, Danny Hoi Tsun et al.
long-covid.excerpt: Persistence of SARS-CoV-2 has been proposed as a biological driver of Long COVID, a disabling chronic illness with no proven treatments. We conducted an exploratory, placebo-controlled, double-blind, 2:1 randomized mechanistic trial (NCT05877508) of the SARS-CoV-2-specific monoclonal antibody AER002 in 36 participants who met the World Health Organization case definition of Long COVID.

Post-COVID Gastrointestinal Symptoms and Disorders of Gut-Brain Interaction: A Focus on Persistent Diarrhea.
long-covid.excerpt: Persistent gastrointestinal (GI) symptoms after SARS-CoV-2 infection include diarrhea, abdominal pain, dyspepsia, constipation, nausea, and other disorders of gut-brain interaction (DGBIs), but these entities should not be treated as interchangeable. In a meta-analysis of long-COVID studies, any GI symptom was reported in approximately 22% of patients and diarrhea in 10%, although heterogeneity was very high.

me-cfs.excerpt: Fatigue is amongst the most debilitating cancer-related symptoms, affecting up to one-third of colorectal cancer (CRC) survivors. Accumulating evidence implicates dysregulation of HPA axis as a potential mechanism contributing to chronic fatigue syndrome.
